universe: 422 S&P 500 stocks a day, as the index was each day

A.name: Your system
A.rules: Last night's setups on the strongest sector, strongest stock list, highest score first; 2 at a time, each at most 30% of the account; sells on your exit (10 EMA under the 20 and price under the 50) or an 8% stop. Buys at the next open. Tested with shares: there's no history of option prices to test the paper account's calls on; the card also shows the calls on a pricing model.

C.name: Your system, after 2 PM
C.rules: The same rules as Your system, but it buys at the next day's close, standing in for after 2 PM.

B.name: Claude's picks
B.rules: AI picks list: top relative strength, hold 10, keep while in the top 20, max 3 per sector, a tenth of the account each; also sold on your exit. Tested with shares (the paper account may buy calls).
